listing.aiSummary: Adds 35 new and modified weapons, including missiles, ballistics, and energy guns.

description:
Work in progess mod. Tested on 0.98
Sector Modding Service (SMS)  (name will change in future )
Independent Weapons designer.

Total 35 weapons :

General Design concept :
Missile :  Long range + heavy Damage .
Mutiple missile options , Mine deployer  , Area Supression
Anti Ship Rocket (Cobra , Viper)
WMD options (Twilight / Twilight  MK2)
Expriemental  (Caustic)
High OP cost

Balistic :  Long range, Standard damage .
Mutiple Ammo options
Improved CIWS  .
High OP cost  .

Engergy : Improved damge
High Flux cost
High OP cost

to add blueprint to your game  , please use command "additem SMS_package"
to add weapon to your game  , please use command "AddWeapon VM_XXXXXXX"

*Some weapon are modify from the vanila game . Plus added some of my own for fun  :)
